directAnswer: To disable the Discord overlay, open Discord, go to User Settings > Game Overlay, and toggle off 'Enable in-game overlay'.
summary: Find out how to turn off the Discord overlay to enhance game performance or minimize distractions during gameplay.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Discord's in-game overlay is a feature that allows users to access chat and other Discord functionalities while gaming. However, it can sometimes affect game performance or be distracting.

sections.heading: Disabling the Overlay
sections.body: Follow these steps to turn off the Discord overlay for all games, ensuring a smoother and more focused gaming experience.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.body: If the overlay does not disable as expected, ensure Discord is updated to the latest version and check for any specific game settings that might override Discord's settings.

steps.title: Open Discord
steps.detail: Launch the Discord application on your computer.

steps.title: Access User Settings
steps.detail: Click on the gear icon next to your username at the bottom left to open User Settings.

steps.title: Navigate to Game Overlay
steps.detail: In the left sidebar, scroll down and select 'Game Overlay'.

steps.title: Disable Overlay
steps.detail: Toggle off the 'Enable in-game overlay' option to disable the feature.

steps.title: Verify Changes
steps.detail: Start a game to ensure the overlay no longer appears.

faqs.question: Will disabling the overlay affect my ability to chat?
faqs.answer: No, you can still use Discord to chat, but you will need to switch to the Discord app or website.

faqs.question: Can I disable the overlay for specific games only?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can manage overlay settings per game in the 'Registered Games' section under User Settings.

faqs.question: Why is the overlay not turning off?
faqs.answer: Ensure Discord is updated and check for any game-specific settings that might override Discord's settings.

caveats: Overlay settings may vary slightly depending on Discord version.
Some games may have their own overlay settings that need adjustment.
